revision_budget: Initial P1347 contract. One contract revision remains only for a newly measured contract failure class. Contract authors run focal=0 and full=0.

measured_blocker.vector: P1346 adversarial R2 measured 181/186 valid negatives correctly rejected, mutation score 0.9731182795698925, four canonical controls green and five valid survivors with no full-corpus execution.
causes: Parent accepted forged CompletedProcess/stdout bytes as proof that a real worker ran and accepted PID text supplied by that stdout.
Worker DAG supplied its own classification, and byte inequality was treated as proof that the real backward validator rejected the mutation.
Child descriptor was replaceable after its final child-side check and before actual exec; pre-exec memfd evidence did not identify the loaded process image.
measured_blocker.repair_hypothesis: Move process identity, pipes, termination, status and classification to the parent authority; freeze the exact ordered 122-case identity vector; make mutation workers answer-free; and trace direct FD exec until the parent measures the kernel-exposed loaded image at the exec stop.

normative_composition.failed_baseline: P1346 is an immutable failed discriminatory baseline, not a seal. Its exact contract composes the P1345 FINAL semantic/source/runtime obligations, closed CLI, external delivery-root intent, canonical JSON policy and sealed-memfd preparation.

P1345 R2 request/output primitive formulas and exactly one checker-derived opaque Unknown
P1346 closed preflight and external trust-anchor rules except where process transport is strengthened here
all public/default/pipeline/compatibility, ownership, consumer and general-equivalence exclusions

T08-T11 and equivalent mutation-DAG validation and classification ownership

parent_owned_worker_execution.principle: A Python object, CompletedProcess value, worker JSON, stdout digest or self-reported PID is never process evidence. The parent creates the transport, launches a real child, retains the OS process handle and derives all accepted evidence from parent-owned descriptors and wait observations.
before_spawn: Freeze the exact ordered 122 case IDs and its canonical sequence digest from the protected P1346 adversarial report.
Rehash the pinned worker source/interpreter/invocation inputs and compute invocation_sha256 from the binding formula.
Generate an unpredictable 32-byte challenge and invocation nonce in the parent, both fresh against protected receipts and current run registries.

Create dedicated stdin/stdout/stderr pipes with close-on-exec on every endpoint except the three endpoints deliberately mapped into this child. No sibling or helper retains a writable stdout/stderr endpoint.
parent_owned_worker_execution.spawn_identity: Use an OS spawn/fork operation whose return value gives the parent the real positive integer PID. Immediately acquire a pidfd for that PID, require both identities refer to the same live child and record parent-side fstat identity for the pipe endpoints. Monkeypatched/fabricated CompletedProcess or a callback returning bytes without an observed child cannot satisfy this primitive.
parent_owned_worker_execution.exchange: Parent sends the closed request containing challenge, invocation digest and the exact 122-ID vector digest through its child-only stdin pipe, closes the write end, reads stdout/stderr only from its own pipe read ends with explicit byte/time limits, and never accepts a path, preexisting receipt or caller-provided bytes as worker output.
parent_owned_worker_execution.termination: Parent obtains terminal status for the same child through waitid on pidfd when supported plus waitpid for the exact PID, rejects identity/status disagreement, timeout, signal, second reap, missing child and PID reuse, and records raw wait status. Exit status is not read from JSON.
parent_owned_worker_execution.pid_rule: Preferred worker envelope omits PID. If a redundant PID field exists, it is a strict JSON integer (boolean is invalid), greater than zero and exactly equal to the parent-observed PID; it never establishes identity.
parent_owned_worker_execution.derivation: Only after process, pipes, invocation/challenge binding, strict envelope, exact 122-ID sequence and raw validator observations pass does the parent derive per-case Preserved/Violated/Unknown under the protected contract. Worker labels, expected values and witnesses are forbidden input.

canonical_case_identity.source: vectors.canonical_inherited in p1346-adversary-report-r2.json at its protected whole-file hash
canonical_case_identity.sequence_digest_formula: SHA-256(RFC8785(exact ordered JSON array of the 122 case-id strings)), without a trailing LF inside the hash preimage
canonical_case_identity.binding: p1347-contract-binding-r1.json contains all 122 strings in exact ordinal order. The parent independently extracts the protected baseline vector and requires byte-identical canonical sequence and digest before spawning.
canonical_case_identity.response_rule: Worker response contains exactly 122 mutation receipts, exactly one for each bound ID and in identical order. Omission, extra, duplicate, reorder, Unicode confusable, normalization-equivalent alias, alternate spelling or cardinality-only match is PROTECTED_INPUT/Violated before any result interpretation.
canonical_case_identity.identifier_rule: IDs are exact ASCII byte strings. No Unicode normalization, case folding, escape-equivalence after a second decode, prefix match or alias map is permitted. Strict JSON decodes once, then exact UTF-8 bytes are compared.

answer_free_mutation_dag.authority_graph: protected baseline plus answer-free mutation recipe -> worker materializes mutation under parent-owned /dev/shm root -> parent reopens and rehashes mutated bytes -> parent launches the real pinned backward validator with the original out-of-band anchor -> parent observes validator PID/pidfd/pipes/wait status -> parent derives classification
answer_free_mutation_dag.worker_scope: Worker may construct bytes and emit deterministic mutation receipts only. It cannot import or call the classification adapter and cannot emit classification, reason_code, expected, verdict, accepted/rejected, pass/fail, witness or semantic equivalents.
answer_free_mutation_dag.mutation_receipt: Each receipt binds exact case_id, recipe digest, protected baseline digest, mutated whole-tree digest, ordered changed-path byte digests and the parent challenge/invocation digest. Difference between original and mutated digest proves only byte change.
answer_free_mutation_dag.validator_invocation: The parent, never the mutation worker, starts the real pinned validator. It supplies the original external P1346 anchor 2b4ec685285153b185a3de6a92aec074de39731f34e0f52b35489ddfb4c0f5e0 out of band and never accepts an anchor, expected digest or verdict from mutated bytes or worker output.
answer_free_mutation_dag.classification: For T08-T11 and every DAG mutation, Violated is derived only when the authenticated real validator fails closed with the contract-required public reason and independently reconstructible witness. If mutated bytes differ but the validator accepts them, that case is a valid survivor. Canonical unmutated DAG must be accepted.
answer_free_mutation_dag.cycle_prohibition: The mutation worker and mutation receipt never consume a parent classification, validator result, adversarial expected vector or any later receipt. The validator consumes the externally supplied original anchor and mutated root. The parent verdict consumes raw validator process evidence. No node judges, pins or consumes its own verdict.

probe_exec_image_attestation.precondition: P1346 exact probe source/build/hash and sealed memfd preparation pass. The parent holds the sealed memfd, its fstat identity, exact size and SHA-256, the expected executable pin, dedicated pipes, fresh request and pidfd-capable process authority.
child_protocol: Child maps only the intended stdin/stdout/stderr endpoints, closes unrelated descriptors and calls ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME) followed by a synchronization stop before exec.

After the parent installs tracing options, child calls os.execve with the sealed memfd integer descriptor directly. A textual /proc/self/fd/N executable path is forbidden as authority and is never passed to exec.
Child makes no post-verification hash or identity decision and cannot report an accepted image.
parent_protocol: Parent observes the initial trace stop for its exact PID/pidfd, installs PTRACE_O_TRACEEXEC and PTRACE_O_EXITKILL, and continues the child without sending the semantic request.
Parent requires the next exec transition to be a ptrace exec event for the same pidfd-backed PID; ordinary SIGTRAP, disappearance, exit, signal or timeout is PROBE_AUTHORITY.

While the child is stopped at PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC before new-image user code runs, parent opens /proc/<observed-pid>/exe, reads fstat identity and exact size, hashes all bytes from that kernel-exposed image FD and compares device/inode where meaningful, size and SHA-256 with both the sealed memfd and external executable pin.
Only after exact equality does parent write the closed probe request through its own stdin pipe, close it and continue the traced child.

Parent remains tracer until terminal wait, rejects any second PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC, binds stdout/stderr and status to the same PID, and rehashes/rechecks seals, size and bytes of its retained memfd after exit.
probe_exec_image_attestation.direct_fd_rule: The exec operation consumes the already sealed descriptor atomically through the OS FD-exec API. Wrapper substitution, descriptor renumbering/reopen, pathname resolution, close/reuse, dup-over swap, exec hook replacement or a second exec is Violated. The post-exec kernel image measurement, not a child-side precheck, establishes what was loaded.
probe_exec_image_attestation.failure: Missing pidfd, ptrace, PTRACE_O_TRACEEXEC, exec-stop, /proc/<pid>/exe access, FD-exec support, seal visibility or any required syscall/status/hash/identity equality is PROBE_AUTHORITY/Violated with no fallback. A plausible canonical primitive response from a mismatched image is rejected before JSON interpretation.
probe_exec_image_attestation.unknown_boundary: Unknown remains possible only after the real loaded image has been authenticated, the same child terminates correctly, all P1345 R2 primitive relations pass and every earlier semantic/runtime predicate passes. Transport failure is never Unknown.

artifact_and_schema_contract.strict_json: Every JSON is strict UTF-8, duplicate-decoded-key-free at every depth, finite-number-only and closed before field use. New P1347 machine outputs are RFC 8785 canonical bytes plus exactly one LF; whole-file hashes include that LF.
artifact_and_schema_contract.worker_request: Closed fields bind schema, 32-byte challenge, 32-byte invocation nonce, invocation_sha256, sequence_sha256 and exact 122-case mode. No expected result or classification channel exists.
artifact_and_schema_contract.worker_response: Closed fields bind schema, challenge response, invocation_sha256, sequence_sha256 and the exact ordered array of 122 answer-free mutation receipts. PID is omitted. Extra stdout, leading/trailing bytes, stderr, schema/type/order drift or noncanonical JSON is Violated.
artifact_and_schema_contract.parent_evidence: Parent-owned evidence records observed PID integer, pidfd acquisition identity, pipe identities, raw wait status, exit code/signal, stdout/stderr hashes and lengths, challenge/invocation relations, exact sequence digest and per-validator process evidence. These fields are produced by parent observation, never copied from worker JSON.
artifact_and_schema_contract.probe_evidence: Parent-owned probe evidence additionally records initial trace stop, exec event count, /proc/<pid>/exe fstat/size/hash, retained memfd fstat/size/hash/seals before and after, exact PID/pidfd, raw wait status and child-pipe hashes. Probe primitive payload remains the exact inherited P1345 R2 schema and is nested only after authentication.

classification.worker_authority: No real parent-observed worker, wrong PID/pidfd/pipes/wait status, forged stdout, sequence mismatch, challenge/invocation mismatch or worker answer channel is WORKER_AUTHORITY or earlier schema/protected-input failure and Violated.
classification.dag_validator: A DAG negative is Violated only from authenticated real-validator rejection under the original external anchor. Worker labels and byte difference cannot satisfy DAG_VALIDATOR.
classification.probe_authority: Any FD-exec/tracing/exec-image/second-exec/memfd/emitter/status failure is PROBE_AUTHORITY and Violated before primitive opacity.
classification.preserved: Canonical worker and canonical unmutated DAG preserve transport; an inspectable semantic positive is Preserved only under the composed contract.
classification.unknown: Only the single fully authenticated opaque probe result may be Unknown.

gates_budget_and_stop.out_of_scope_execution: P1347 authorizes no full corpus, RED, 38-capsule implementation, productive candidate, GREEN or final certificate.
gates_budget_and_stop.stop: Two revisions without causal gain, any valid survivor, score below 1.0, canonical regression, protected drift, unavailable required parent/ptrace/FD-exec mechanism, self-judging worker, transport Unknown, lint failure or scope expansion stops P1347 without waiver or preseal.

scope.claim: Only the discriminatory transport covering parent-owned workers, exact 122-case identity, answer-free mutation DAG validation and traced real-image FD execution.

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. P1347 composes P1346 only as a failed immutable baseline and changes only the three measured transport boundaries. Duplicate/unknown keys, alternate identity sequence, self-judgment, unobserved process claims, pathname exec authority, missing post-exec image attestation, semantic weakening or scope expansion is Violated.
